def make_lpm(prefixes):
    """Fast LPM oracle: binary trie over (addr,len,hop)."""
    trie = [dict(ch={}, hop=None)]
    for (a, l, h) in prefixes:
        cur = 0
        for d in range(l):
            b = (a >> (127 - d)) & 1
            nxt = trie[cur]['ch'].get(b)
            if nxt is None:
                nxt = len(trie); trie.append(dict(ch={}, hop=None)); trie[cur]['ch'][b] = nxt
            cur = nxt
        trie[cur]['hop'] = h
    ch = [t['ch'] for t in trie]; hp = [t['hop'] for t in trie]
    def q(a):
        cur = 0; best = hp[0]
        for d in range(128):
            nxt = ch[cur].get((a >> (127 - d)) & 1)
            if nxt is None: break
            cur = nxt
            if hp[cur] is not None: best = hp[cur]
        return best
    return q
